column4: Data refer to the sum of all embarking cruise passengers (i.e. those who arrived in Singapore by air or land but departed on a cruise), disembarking cruise passengers (i.e. those who arrived on a cruise ship but departed by other means) and full-cruise passengers (i.e. those who arrived and departed on the same cruise ship).  In addition, the numbers include all cruise passengers who are Singaporean citizens or permanent residents.
